name: Securities Balance Type 7 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the securities or investment fund balance.

COLA.name: Eligible For Collateral Purposes
COLA.definition: Balance of securities that are eligible for use for collateral purposes.

CLEN.name: Tax Exempt
CLEN.definition: Tax-exempt financial instruments are to be settled.

DIRT.name: Non Tax Exempt
DIRT.definition: Taxable financial instruments are to be settled.

NOMI.name: Registered
NOMI.definition: Balance of financial instruments that are registered (in nominee name or in the name of the beneficial owner).

SPOS.name: Street Position
SPOS.definition: Balance of financial instruments that remain registered in the name of the prior beneficial owner.

UNRG.name: Unregistered
UNRG.definition: Balance of securities that could not be registered due to foreign ownership limitation.

ISSU.name: Issued
ISSU.definition: In issuer agent / depository communication, balance of issued financial instruments for which legal documentation has been received.

QUAS.name: Quasi Issued
QUAS.definition: In issuer agent / depository communication, balance of issued financial instruments for which legal documentation has not yet been received.
